provenance_note.scorer_representation_caveat: cb-probe has no per-response panel. Each (response, judge) rating is recorded as one scorer trial, so provenance.trials_per_item = trials x judges and uncertainty.* treats the two judges' ratings of one response as independent trials. Intervals are therefore narrower than a response-clustered interval, and trial_stats mixes sampling variance with judge disagreement. judge_panel.per_item compares judges that each rated a different two-thirds of a subject's responses. See the sibling audit file for the response-level mapping and paired agreement.
